description: This file contains Data Transfer Object (DTO) definitions using pydantic models for a vehicle monitoring and maintenance system. It defines request and response models for assets, telemetry data, and alerts, including their fields and descriptions.

classes.name: AssetCreateRequest
classes.description: DTO for creating an asset, including id, name, and type.

classes.name: AssetResponse
classes.description: DTO for asset details response, including creation timestamp.

classes.name: TelemetryIngestRequest
classes.description: DTO for ingesting telemetry data, including timestamp, asset id, and sensor readings.

classes.name: TelemetryRecordResponse
classes.description: DTO for telemetry record response, including database id, timestamp, asset id, and readings.

classes.name: TelemetryIngestResponse
classes.description: DTO for telemetry ingestion results, including count and list of inserted record ids.

classes.name: AlertCreateRequest
classes.description: DTO for creating an alert, including asset id, severity, and message.

classes.name: AlertAckRequest
classes.description: DTO for acknowledging an alert, including who acknowledged and optional comment.

classes.name: AlertResponse
classes.description: DTO for alert details response, including id, asset id, severity, message, state, timestamps, and acknowledgment info.
